query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `olfaction_memory_article_sources` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `article_id` int NOT NULL,
  `source_id` int NOT NULL,
  `citation_context` text,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  INDEX `article_source_article_idx` (`article_id`),
  INDEX `article_source_source_idx` (`source_id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `article_source_unique` (`article_id`, `source_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `olfaction_memory_article_concepts` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `article_id` int NOT NULL,
  `concept_id` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  INDEX `article_concept_article_idx` (`article_id`),
  INDEX `article_concept_concept_idx` (`concept_id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `article_concept_unique` (`article_id`, `concept_id`)
);
